Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.</span></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Credit Risk Operations owns Adyen's global arrears and collections flow for our financial products. When a merchant falls behind on repayment, we work to recover what is owed while keeping the relationship intact and staying fully compliant.</p> <p>We sit at the intersection of Credit Risk, Product, Finance, Legal and our second-line Risk and Compliance teams. The team is growing quickly, so the processes, tooling and playbooks you help build now will shape how Adyen collects at scale.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Credit Operations Analyst, Collections &amp; Recovery in Chicago, you will own a portfolio of US merchants in arrears across Adyen's financial products: cash advances, capital loans, charge cards, overdrafts and hardware financing. You will resolve each case end to end, from first outreach to repayment plan, recovery or escalation. Alongside your caseload, you will help turn a fast-growing operation into a scalable, compliant and increasingly automated one.</p> <p>You will run your own portfolio independently, within agreed playbooks and approval limits.
